body:
No images? [Click here](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-e-fhkyhjy-hhlljjcji-h/) **YOU'RE INVITED: ELECTION NIGHT WATCH PARTY!** Election Day is almost here, and we want YOU to join us!After months of hard work, knocking doors, making calls, and connecting with voters across Indiana, it's time to come together on Election Night!Join the **Indiana Republican Party** on **Tuesday, November 3** , in Indianapolis as we gather with Republican candidates, elected officials, and supporters to watch the election results roll in.We'll be joined by our Republican statewide ticket:
* **Max Engling** - Secretary of State Candidate
* **Elise Nieshalla** - State Comptroller
* **Daniel Elliott** - State Treasurer

**EVENT DETAILS**
* 📅 **Tuesday, November 3, 2026**
* 🕕**Doors Open: 6:00 p.m. EST**
* 📍**Indianapolis, Indiana**

For more information and event details, please contact [**rsvp@indiana.gop**](mailto:rsvp@indiana.gop).**We hope to see you there!** And remember, there's still time to make your voice heard! Early voting is underway, and Election Day is Tuesday, November 3.**Make a plan to vote and encourage your friends, family, and neighbors to do the same!** [](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhkyhjy-hhlljjcji-r/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhkyhjy-hhlljjcji-y/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhkyhjy-hhlljjcji-j/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhkyhjy-hhlljjcji-t/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhkyhjy-hhlljjcji-i/)[](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhkyhjy-hhlljjcji-d/) ** PAID FOR BY THE INDIANA REPUBLICAN STATE COMMITTEE. ****NOT AUTHORIZED BY ANY CANDIDATE OR CANDIDATE'S COMMITTEE. ****WWW.INDIANA.GOP.** | Indiana Republican State Committee 101 W.
